insight.title: How the light beneath our feet shapes your world
insight.subtitle: A quiet dance of glass and pulses connecting every moment

sections.text: Our world is held together by threads of glass. Beneath the concrete and under the salt of the deep ocean, billions of tiny light pulses race through hair-thin fibers. They carry every message you send and every memory you share. While the sky feels like the source of magic, the true power lives in the silent ground.

Instead of slow electricity, we use the speed of pure light. Think of it as a Morse code made of flashes, bouncing off the inside of glass tubes without ever escaping. This sequence of brightness creates the digital world. It is a tireless, luminous river flowing quietly through the dark earth.

This invisible net turns your morning routine into a global symphony. When you tap a screen, you aren’t just touching glass; you are reaching across continents in an eye-blink. Distance has become a choice rather than a barrier. We have replaced the physical weight of paper with the weightless speed of the sun.
We are no longer limited by where we stand, but by where we choose to look.

news.title: Danger at every step: F-15E airman's rescue mission is red flag for Trump's Iran plans
news.description: A wounded US F-15E gunner spent nearly two days hiding in Iran's rugged mountains as US special forces, drones and CIA deception tactics raced against time and an Iranian manhunt. While the rescue ended in a success, Washington allegedly blew up some of its own aircraft worth billions on Iranian soil. This episode is a costly preview of what Donald Trump's boots-on-the-ground plan for Kharg Island could look like.
